items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thursday, making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1, no practice progress.
items.implication: Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary; Tre Harris deep stash.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) listed as non-participant Thursday after injuring it Wednesday; doctors don't believe serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. History of multi-game absences on hammy.
items.why: Hamstring strain at practice, MRI pending; 37/42 routes Week 1.
items.implication: High risk sit; boosts Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and Schultz TE.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday second straight; Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist on IR. If Flowers out, Ravens WR order: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: Bateman flex upside; Andrews target share rises.
items.opportunity: WR hierarchy shift, more snaps/routes for backups.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant, says 'I'm ready to go' for Week 2 home opener vs Steelers after missing opener.
items.implication: RB committee reset; Stevenson handcuff reverse.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target rate on routes (tied lead), 24% share Week 1 debut with KC; Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TD to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season if healthy.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 (tied Bijan lead) Week 1 under Kubiak; 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3/4 last. Overreaction to injury scare.
ETR Week 2 waivers: Ladd McConkey out = Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane = Bateman/Moore; De'Zhaun Stribling = Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara = Kendre Miller (reverse if in); AJ Brown = Doubs. Deebo top add.
items.why: Precise injury beneficiaries with FAAB/stream notes.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee meniscus trim) DNP again Thursday, yet to practice post-surgery; Levitan notes legit chance return Week 2 or 3 despite prior PCL/bone bruise history on same knee.
items.why: Coach hopes practice this week; short recovery expected.
items.implication: Mayer fringe TE1 if out; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If IN, full TE1 role resumes.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow listed limited participant second consecutive day Thursday due to back injury.
items.implication: Monitor; expects play but volume risk for Chase/Higgins.

items.text: Berry back in on DeVonta Smith LOVE this week @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1; TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets WRs, 6th-most FPPG to WRs.
Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; Bears allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% target share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, all RB RZ touches Week 1; CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% FPTS via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further; 8.5 UD underdog script poor for rush.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Miller beneficiary reverse if Kamara in.

items.text: Berry LOVES Dalton Kincaid vs DET: 69% routes (career high vs last year), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9); DET allowed 27 FPTS to TEs Week 1.
